prompt:
stylized-concept. Create one clean 3-by-3 gaze atlas from the supplied exact 1536x840 nearest-neighbor reference grid. Each cell is a complete 64x35 upper portrait at identical scale, in a 192x105-cell atlas with no gutters, labels, text, borders, or added padding. The supplied grid repeats the exact same native portrait as a visual source; do not reproduce nine identical outputs.

Keep the face, hair, skin, lighting, texture, eyebrows, and all pixels outside the two eye-feature rectangles unchanged from the reference. Keep both eyes coherent, narrow, naturally hooded, and the same size. Do not enlarge the eye openings or thicken brows.

Make a clearly readable row-major gaze matrix: UP-LEFT, UP, UP-RIGHT; LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT; DOWN-LEFT, DOWN, DOWN-RIGHT. Both irises and pupils move together in each named direction and agree across both eyes. Diagonals combine the horizontal and vertical movement.

At native 64x35 scale, keep every top-row iris/pupil center 1 to 2 pixels HIGHER than its matching middle-row center. Keep the middle row centered vertically. For every bottom-row gaze, move the iris and pupil themselves visibly DOWN by at least 1 native pixel relative to the matching middle-row center, aiming for 2 native pixels only where the narrow opening allows. Do not make bottom-row gaze by merely lowering or darkening the upper lid over an unmoved iris. Keep the lower lid/source eye identity fixed. The upper lid may follow the down gaze by at most one native pixel if needed for a natural gaze, but the iris must still be visibly lower and retain a recognizable violet-gray cluster partly visible above the fixed lower lid. Keep the top-row shifts and clear horizontal glances.

Preserve the source's compact three-native-pixel-wide muted violet-gray iris/pupil structure. Do not make irises rounder, larger, brighter, or more saturated. Keep sclera and highlights tiny and source-like; no large white crescents, giant whites, or bright flashes. Use the exact source palette and pixel texture. Do not add details or change expression. Return only the 3x3 atlas.
